// The safe forms of the same code: the Semgrep rules must find nothing here (no false positive on the patterns the
// codebase uses). Copied as good.ts by the tests, never compiled.
import { execFile } from "node:child_process";
import { createHash, createCipheriv } from "node:crypto";
import * as fs from "node:fs";

const COLUMNS = "id, name";
const id = (client: any, name: string) => client.escapeIdentifier(name);

export async function sql(client: any, householdId: string, schema: string) {
  await client.query("SELECT * FROM accounts WHERE household_id = $1", [householdId]);
  await client.query(`SELECT ${COLUMNS} FROM accounts WHERE household_id = $1`, [householdId]);
  await client.query(`SET LOCAL search_path = ${client.escapeIdentifier(schema)}, pg_temp`);
  await client.query(`CREATE SCHEMA IF NOT EXISTS ${id(client, schema)}`);
  await client.query(`ALTER ROLE x PASSWORD ${client.escapeLiteral("p")}`);
}

export function shell(file: string) {
  execFile("convert", [file, "out.png"]);
  return /x/.exec(file);
}

export function download(fileId: string) {
  return fs.readFileSync(`/data/${fileId}`);
}

export function back(reply: any) {
  return reply.redirect("/");
}

export function render(el: any, text: string) {
  el.textContent = text;
  el.innerHTML = "";
}

export function digest(data: string, key: Buffer, iv: Buffer) {
  createCipheriv("aes-256-gcm", key, iv);
  return createHash("sha256").update(data).digest("hex");
}

export const config = { password: process.env.SOME_PASSWORD, token: "short" };
